baselineIdentitySource: Parent supplied exact clean origin/main baseline before fixes. Findings describe pre-fix files read in this review.

findings.title: Action source identity is erased
findings.counterexample: ActionRef carries only module/action and model classes; capture stores only (module,action). Same-named actions with different declaration bytes become indistinguishable compilation identities.
findings.repair: Carry immutable full source descriptor from exact retained document through generated ActionRef and CapturedDeclaration, preserving invocation profile; no issued revision claim.

findings.title: Action Python aliases silently erase parameters
findings.counterexample: Two shipOrder input name overrides set to same: candidate with no diagnostics emits two same assignments, allowing optional memo to overwrite required entity Key. Outputs use the same unguarded path.
findings.repair: Reject duplicate resolved Python names separately in each action input/output namespace before emission.
findings.disposition: fixed; targeted tests pass; final integrated rereview pending

findings.title: Required selectedKey is rejected while omission is accepted
findings.counterexample: A valid explicit Order selectedKey produces UNKNOWN_RELEVANT; omission returns candidate and emitter chooses keys[0].
findings.repair: Require and resolve selectedKey exactly. Keep unsupported multiple/alternate Keys refused rather than infer a first Key; update current schemas/fixtures without rewriting historical evidence.
findings.disposition: fixed; targeted tests pass; final integrated rereview pending

findings.title: Generated update signature retains known ty unknown-key escape
findings.counterexample: Generated **values: Unpack[RecordUpdate] is explicitly superseded because ty does not reject unknown keyword names. Recovery static evidence only runs mypy and pyright.
findings.repair: Emit explicit keyword-only mutable fields with MISSING defaults; add ty and positive/negative corpus checks.

findings.title: Column RHS erases owning Record in static comparisons
findings.counterexample: Column[Any,T] admits foreign-owner RHS for a comparison whose result is typed as the left Record predicate. Runtime capture later refuses but static rejection promised by the current contract is missing.
findings.governing: CONTRACT-068 Field expressions; CONTRACT-071 owner-set restriction
findings.repair: Use Column[O,T] and add foreign-owner RHS negatives across all supported comparison operators/checkers.

findings.title: Generated rejection type cannot represent reserved missing entity
findings.counterexample: ShipOrderRejected literal is only NOT_READY; ENTITY_MISSING is omitted, and construction with that reserved result raises KeyError instead of a typed rejection. Existing test enshrines the omission.
findings.repair: Include reserved ENTITY_MISSING; preserve retryable classification from original results rather than indexing only declared failures.

findings.title: Grouped count has no result bound
findings.counterexample: group_by(value).count() renders SELECT value, COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY value without LIMIT. Every distinct value may become a returned row; count renderer rejects a limit and Grouped offers no bound.
findings.governing: CONTRACT-071 Grouped counts must remain bounded by an admitted limit/page
findings.repair: Expose explicit group-result limit and enforce it for group_count; preserve unbounded-input single-row global count.
findings.disposition: fixed; targeted tests pass; final integrated rereview pending

findings.title: Decode error text leaks input map keys
findings.section: emitted decode model_validate calls; equivalent new codec_support.decode_model path
findings.counterexample: Invalid dict value under key private-customer@example.invalid appears in str(ValidationError) as data.private-customer@example.invalid despite hide_input_in_errors=True. Encode revalidation already strips untrusted location components, but decode calls model_validate directly.
findings.governing: CONTRACT-068 Codecs and errors: messages name field/rule without input values
findings.repair: Use one sanitized validation boundary for decoded data, retaining trusted declared field names only, with nested-map and extra-key leak regressions.

findings.title: Reused item Fields skip nested presence and mutation rules
findings.counterexample: Reuse owned nullable/mutable memo as itemType of new memos array. collect ignores the already-seen nested occurrence; generation returns candidate although item Fields must be immutable and cannot carry missing. Nested-only nullable Fields also permit false null flags despite the complete nested F/T rule.
findings.governing: CONTRACT-070 FieldView item/value rules and shared occurrence Conflict rules
findings.repair: Track every nested occurrence even when Field already owned; require both owned and nested rules, with exact nullable/nonnullable nested presence.
findings.disposition: fixed; nested compatible/incompatible reuse and exact nested presence controls pass

findings.title: Host writer omitted the fourth stage-two path
findings.counterexample: Existing _umf/privileges.json is treated as an unexpected stage-one file and causes OUTPUT_CHANGED instead of preservation during regeneration.
findings.governing: CONTRACT-067 stage ownership; CONTRACT-071 privilege artifact
findings.repair: Reserve and preserve all four stage-two paths; add drift-check and regeneration regression with privileges.json present.
findings.discoverer: parent implementation reviewer; independently inspected corrected writer
findings.disposition: fixed by parent; focused rereview confirms all four reserved paths

scopeLimits: Recovery receipts expressly limit claims to experimental components, not full slices or native targets; no false full-qualification claim is attributed to them.

The recovered implementation initially copied validator/codec algorithms into generated source; repairs move these to shared runtime metadata helpers. Full Python 3.11/ty profile, stage-two provenance/runtime load checks, generated action clients/results and target adapters remain absent or partial. These are recorded qualification/implementation gaps, not all new source correctness defects.
Current CONTRACT-068 Key identity explicitly excludes build digest; existing no-digest KEY_IDENTITY is not a finding.
